summary: Iteration 2: tested SalonFlow v2 (R1-R20) backend + frontend. Backend: new pytest suite test_v2_features.py (25 tests) covering OTP portal auth, multi-service booking, deposits/release_unpaid, checkout/caja/void/commissions, reviews, ICS, late cancel, inventory, client lookup/photo consent, media upload, signup/slug/billing quote+activate, reminder email fallback -> 25/25 pass. Old backend_test.py updated (stale past TEST_DATE; /my phone-only lookup intentionally removed by R1) -> total 63/63 pass. Frontend (Playwright): portal (title/lang, description, maps, hours, team, footer+legal dialog, steps, multi-service w/ 'Asígnenme', deposit info w/ bank data, phone validation, success w/ Google Calendar + .ics, 'Hoy ya no hay turnos' msg), Mis citas OTP -> account w/ points, upcoming, history + Repetir; review page 1-5 once; panel dashboard (guía de arranque, QR, Pendientes de cerrar, alerta sucursal sin dirección), agenda legend, deposit received, cancel confirmation dialog, Atendida -> Cobro en caja (mixed payment, tip, discount reason), drag&drop reschedule, Nueva cita client lookup + allergy alert + phone validation, client allergy banner + photo consent rejection, caja totals, comisiones, inventario, reseñas, config policies/legal/portal fields, signup minimal + slug suggestions, Activar mi plan quote w/ IVA. Found 1 high UI bug (templates modal off-screen) and several minor issues.

minor.issue: deposit_due = now + deposit_hours even when the appointment starts sooner than that; release_unpaid may never free the slot before the appointment. Cap deposit_due at min(now+hrs, appointment start - buffer).
Voiding a service sale reopens the appointment to 'confirmed' but does not revert loyalty points or service product consumption; re-checkout awards points and consumes stock again (double counting).
'Hora' column uses created_at[11:16] which is UTC (shows 03:07 for a 21:07 local cobro). Convert to salon timezone.
Inventory counter-sale UI never sends branch_id, so product sales appear under '-' in Caja 'Por sucursal' and are excluded when filtering by branch.

ui_bugs.issue: Modal is rendered with custom 'fixed inset-0' div inside PageHeader actions; an ancestor has transform/animation (fade-up) so 'fixed' is relative to the header box. At 1920x1080 the dialog top is at y=-223: title and first template rows are off-screen/unreachable, overlay only dims the header strip. Playwright click on template-check-0 fails ('element is outside of the viewport'). Fix: use shadcn <Dialog> (portal) or ReactDOM.createPortal(document.body).
Fixed mobile-summary-bar (57px) covers the bottom of the portal footer (Términos/Privacidad/Contacto links). Add bottom padding (e.g. pb-20 lg:pb-0) to the portal container.
'Registrar cobro' button stays enabled when payments don't sum to total or discount has no reason; only backend 400 toast stops it. Disable submit until balance==total and reason provided.

integration_issues.issue: Observed once each (not reproducible on retry): after changing agenda-date right after page load, the grid kept showing the previous day's appointments (stale response race - no request cancellation/ignore-stale guard in load()); signup submit once did not proceed. Consider ignoring stale responses (AbortController / request id).

issues: Logo/Foto file inputs are native unstyled inputs showing English 'Choose File / No file chosen' in a Spanish UI
'Ajustar' uses window.prompt twice (native dialogs) instead of a styled dialog with qty+motivo fields; products CRUD fine
Reprogramar uses native date/time pickers; 'Mis citas' phone input has no country-code selector unlike the booking form

action_items: HIGH: Fix 'Usar plantillas' modal positioning (render via portal / shadcn Dialog) in components/Onboarding.jsx
Add bottom padding on portal for mobile so footer links aren't hidden behind mobile-summary-bar
Show Caja 'Hora' (and xlsx) in salon local time
Send branch_id from Inventario counter sale (add branch selector)
On void sale: revert loyalty points and service stock consumption (or prevent double award on re-checkout)
Disable checkout submit until payments balance and discount reason are valid
Optional: styled file inputs, replace window.prompt in inventory adjust, ignore stale agenda responses
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend depositOf() in Portal.jsx uses svc.duration only; backend deposit_for uses duration incl. add-ons -> preview can differ from charged anticipo when add-ons push duration over min_minutes

Note for E1: by the configured rule (>=120 min, 30%) only Balayage (180) and Keratina (150) require deposit; Tinte (90 min) does NOT (review request said Tinte too) - behavior is consistent with the rule
Demo stylists have no commission_pct/fixed/base_salary set, so /app/comisiones shows Q0 commission for all - seed some values for a meaningful demo
slots-multi useEffect in Portal.jsx has no .catch -> on API error loader spins forever
billing/activate stores client-supplied 'card' object as-is (not re-validated against a tokenize record) - acceptable for simulated gateway but note for real integration
CORS still allow_origins from CORS_ORIGINS defaulting to '*' with allow_credentials=True

rca of the issue: Templates modal: custom fixed overlay div is a descendant of an element with CSS transform (fade-up animation on PageHeader/actions), which creates a new containing block for position:fixed; dialog is centered relative to the header strip (top ≈ -223px) instead of the viewport. Repro: login as a company_admin, /app/servicios, click 'Usar plantillas' at 1920x1080. Mitigation: portal the modal to document.body (shadcn Dialog).
